value.account: Cause: from 2.29 the compiler seeds an exhausted-placeholder materialize step and emits a generated {ref} override for inactive-variant non-scalar loop outputs (result__report). Two things then broke. (1) validation.py _validate_repeat_until_on_exhausted rejected any relpath override before checking for the compiler-emitted generated ref; I moved the generated-ref check first. It only fires when allow_generated_repeat_until_on_exhausted_refs is set (compiler path) and the ref exactly equals the captured one, so authored workflows still get 'may only override scalar'. (2) After that compiled, exhaustion failed at runtime: the loop artifact result__report stays a raw {ref} dict and the match join validated it as a relpath (invalid_relpath). In executor.py _resolve_structured_output_artifacts I now chase a {ref} value read from a LoopOutputAddress through _resolve_ref_value before contract validation; the dereferenced placeholder then passes the same relpath validation as 2.28's literal. Provider output is unaffected (values still validated; ../evil still fails the run). Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths.py runs a reduced program end to end with a patched provider at 2.28/2.29/2.32 for exhaustion, done and malformed path; 5 fail without the fix. Related modules (loader_validation, loop_recur, scoped_union_guards, loops_exhaustion_state, rich_loop_values_e2e, human_input_e2e) pass. Considered: stopping the compiler from emitting placeholder overrides for relpath fields (would match 2.28 literally, but changes 2.29+ lowering/the generated-ref design and the placeholder step); discarded in favour of fixing the consumers. Not covered: nested/list-of-path inactive fields beyond what the list test already exercises, targets 2.30/2.31 individually (2.29 and 2.32 tested), no full suite run, nothing committed.
value.summary: Loop results with a path field in a non-exhausted union variant now compile and run identically at 2.29-2.32 as at 2.28, via a validator ordering fix and a runtime ref dereference.

notes: La prueba de ruta inválida falla en la frontera del proveedor; no ejercita una referencia generada inválida después del bucle.
No se ejecutó la suite completa; sí las pruebas nuevas, módulos relacionados y comprobaciones adicionales en 2.30/2.31 y listas de rutas.
